STATE_PRESERVATION_INTEGRITY.why: Outside a return, a weekly review records the next week's start as WEEK_EVIDENCE and carries unchanged every value its evidence did not move from the week's own start, even when that start was an unverified projection. historicalWeekStart checks that base only while return steps are under way. So in a program's first weeks, after a SHORT return or after a completed return, values only the plan assumed become evidence-anchored history (P40: db-rdl and db-split-squat at 22 kg, lifted at 20; P40b 9 of 9 cells; P40c a moderate return's ceiling; P41 after a short return; P47b through a Sunday local-fatigue report). R7A-FINAL-FREEZE carries the same values on that path: the path is older than this mission, which did not reach it
STATE_PRESERVATION_INTEGRITY.holds: QE-R7AF-01's path is closed: on P30c every trigger gives the control's start, and on P30b no cell advances the run. Identity holds: P31 V1, V2, V4 and V5 = 0 at four time zones. The SSCTR found 0 unexecuted run steps over 22 return paths

Completed sessions anchor a projection only when executed exactly as it assumed. Time alone promotes nothing
